name: incident.io
overview: Connect incident.io so LaunchDarkly can send alerts to an incident.io HTTP alert source.
description: Connect incident.io to LaunchDarkly. Today each configuration connects one incident.io HTTP alert source with its URL and bearer token, so LaunchDarkly can send alerts to it, for example to create and resolve incident.io alerts when an observability alert fires or recovers.
author: LaunchDarkly

formVariables.name: Alert source URL
formVariables.description: In incident.io, create an alert source of type **HTTP** (choose Default, not Custom) and paste its URL here. It looks like `https://api.incident.io/v2/alert_events/http/<id>`.

formVariables.name: Alert source bearer token
formVariables.description: The bearer token of the same incident.io HTTP alert source. incident.io shows it when you create the alert source. LaunchDarkly sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
